added_failure_note: the reviewed manifest declares no baseline_suite and after_suite; its single gate.log is a complete after arm at 60fc95f6 reading 58 passed exit 0 with zero failures, so it adds no failure regardless of the base and the added-failure count is zero. The negative-control failures are a deliberate mutation, not added failures.

findings.text: follow-on: the settled surface keeps --score-only as a deprecated alias (wiki.py:1217, mapped to flush at wiki.py:1316) although the plan's option table lists --score-only among the spellings --flush replaces; the fold is the settlement point for the domain's options, so the alias is a compatibility shim the plan did not ask to retain. It is deleted with the wrapper by the retire-domain-subcommands node, so the exposure is bounded.

follow-on: the embedding-server-unavailable hint still directs the user to '--scan-only / --score-only' (wiki.py:147) although this fold settles the draining half as --flush and demotes --score-only to a deprecated alias, so the user-facing message recommends the spelling the fold is retiring; it should name --flush.

follow-on: the WikiStageOptions docstring is phrased as a changelog — 'the settled spelling of the old --source' (wiki.py:35), 'the old free-text --focus' (wiki.py:38) — which the repo's naming rule discourages; the field descriptions would read the same named by mechanism alone.

follow-on: the reviewed gate log's command header prints UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=<main> rather than the absolute path, and the worktree run records no module.__file__ or resolved cwd, so the log is not fully self-binding to 60fc95f6 and is tied to it only through the manifest's word; recording the literal command header and the imported module path would close that gap.

item_verdicts.call_sites: run_wiki_stage has one production caller, the wiki click command (wiki.py:1187 wrapper); the wiki command is registered at imas_codex/cli/discover/__init__.py:519-522 (import then discover.add_command(wiki)); no other module imports run_wiki_stage or WikiStageOptions outside the new test file.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 0031d00ac7 to head 60fc95f6. Commit efe8c54d extracts WikiStageOptions and run_wiki_stage and renames --source to --wiki-site, --max-pages to --limit, the free-text --focus to --topic, and --score-only to --flush (keeping --score-only as a deprecated alias), and adds -t for --time. Commit 60fc95f6 repairs the --focus guard, which read options.topic instead of the focus tuple and so raised AttributeError rather than the refusal, and adds the verbose field the wrapper passes so option construction no longer fails. Every option rename is a one-for-one substitution of the same value into the same engine kwarg, so no engine behaviour changed.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when is four behaviours in the new test file plus the old tests passing. tests/cli/test_discover_wiki_stage.py proves each: --scan-only enumerates pages and passes scan_only to the engine (test_scan_only_selects_the_seeding_half), --flush skips enumeration and passes score_only (test_flush_selects_the_draining_half), --topic reaches the engine's focus kwarg (test_topic_reaches_the_scorer), --limit caps pages (test_limit_caps_pages), and --focus is refused with a message naming the mechanism and no plan name or section (test_focus_items_are_refused_stating_the_mechanism, test_cli_focus_is_refused). The CLI reaches the engine for both halves (test_cli_scan_only_reaches_the_engine, test_cli_flush_reaches_the_engine), and the gate records 58 passed exit 0, including tests/test_cli.py's 45 that drove the old command registration.
item_verdicts.goal: the plan's fold-wiki-stage node turns imas_codex/cli/discover/wiki.py into run_wiki_stage(facility, options) with a frozen WikiStageOptions dataclass of the settled options, leaving the wiki click command as a thin wrapper that builds the options and calls the stage, with the engine body kept whole. The landed WikiStageOptions (wiki.py:30-59) carries wiki_site, limit, topic, scan_only, flush, focus, and the remaining tunables, and run_wiki_stage routes each to the engine under its own kwarg, so the goal is met, with --score-only retained as a deprecated alias.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commits efe8c54d and 60fc95f6, changed_paths (two files), the gate command with 58 passed exit 0 in logs/gate.log, the negative-control result (2 failed, exit 1) with its log path, and names no baseline_suite or after_suite, so no separate base arm exists.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares imas_codex/cli/discover/wiki.py and tests/cli/test_discover_wiki_stage.py; git diff 0031d00ac7..60fc95f6 touches exactly those two files and no path outside them changed.

justifications.durability: the new test file measures each settled option at the seam that carries it, the kwargs the engine (run_parallel_wiki_discovery) receives, so the assertions do not depend on progress-rendering detail: test_scan_only_selects_the_seeding_half, test_flush_selects_the_draining_half, test_topic_reaches_the_scorer, test_limit_caps_pages, test_wiki_site_selects_one_site. The declared negative control mutates the engine's score_only kwarg and genuinely reddens two flush tests, so the guard is shown to fail when broken, and the --focus refusal has a positive test (test_focus_items_are_refused_stating_the_mechanism, test_cli_focus_is_refused). The only untested seam is that --topic and --limit are measured through run_wiki_stage rather than end-to-end through the CLI, and the --score-only alias is 还是 tested only for its mapping to flush.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed run's gate log at logs/gate.log carries a revision/tree/command header (# revision: 60fc95f64, # tree: 0 modified/untracked paths) and reads 58 passed, 1 warning in 9.41s with EXIT=0 at the reviewed head, and its declared negative control at logs/negative-control.log reads 2 failed, 11 passed, EXIT=1 naming test_flush_selects_the_draining_half and test_cli_flush_reaches_the_engine, so the flush guard is shown to fire when the behaviour is broken. Two weaknesses keep this below the top band: the command header prints UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=<main> rather than an absolute path, and the worktree run names no module.__file__ or resolved cwd, so the log is bound to 60fc95f6 only through the manifest's word; and no base arm is recorded. The absence of a base arm does not leave the added-failure count unknown: the after arm is a complete run with zero failures, so it adds nothing regardless of the base.
justifications.fit: the module follows the repo idiom: a frozen dataclass of settled options, one stage function, a click command, and a module docstring; neither source file carries a plan name or section number, and the tests assert the refusal message names none. The WikiStageOptions docstring at wiki.py:35-38 is phrased as a changelog ('the settled spelling of the old --source', 'the old free-text --focus'), which the repo's naming rule discourages in favour of naming by mechanism.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/cli/discover/wiki.py:30 defines the frozen WikiStageOptions and wiki.py:74 defines run_wiki_stage(facility, options); the click wrapper at wiki.py:1187 builds the options and calls the stage, so the stage is exposed as the plan describes and the body that builds the engine and calls run_discovery is kept whole (no engine change). Each settled spelling routes one-for-one into the engine — wiki_site to base_url selection, limit to page_limit, topic to the engine's focus kwarg, scan_only to scan_only, flush to score_only — matching the plan's option table. The gap is that the wrapper keeps --score-only as a deprecated alias (wiki.py:1217, mapped at wiki.py:1316) although the table lists --score-only among the spellings --flush replaces, and the embedding hint at wiki.py:147 still recommends --score-only, so the settled surface is not fully settled.
justifications.reuse: the engine and its kwargs are unchanged — the fold substitutes option values one-for-one and forks nothing — and run_wiki_stage imports run_discovery from imas_codex.cli.discover.common and each wiki helper from imas_codex.discovery.wiki.* rather than re-implementing them; a search of imas_codex found no prior stage-function owner for wiki, so no capability was duplicated.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 0031d00ac7..60fc95f6478d198456029d65d49b9bcb78d67b47 changes exactly two paths — imas_codex/cli/discover/wiki.py (251 insertions, 149 deletions) and the new tests/cli/test_discover_wiki_stage.py — and both lie inside the reviewed manifest's declared changed_paths. No path outside them changed; the command registration in imas_codex/cli/discover/__init__.py is untouched.
